reviews.text:
Such a lovely experience. Everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming, especially considering they’d been put in a difficult position by my pup's former owner. I really appreciated the understanding and kindness they showed me.
A special thank you to Hugh, who was wonderful with my scared little Ruby. She was nervous at first, but quickly relaxed with his gentle, patient approach.
We’ll sadly be moving to a practice closer to home purely because of the distance, but I genuinely wish you were closer — I’d happily keep Ruby in your lovely hands. 🐾💕
Incredibly friendly vets who do a really brilliant job. Really impressed with the quality of care and great customer service provided by staff. Thank you Medivet Dalston!

I called for advice after my cat had been sick for several consecutive days. While I was told it did not sound like an emergency, when I asked for their professional recommendation on when persistent vomiting would warrant a check-up, I was repeatedly told it was entirely up to me whether I brought him in.

I found this frustrating. I was not asking them to make the decision for me, but for clinical guidance on when repeated vomiting becomes concerning enough to be assessed. I would expect a veterinary practice to be able to give some general professional guidance on that.

Incredible vets but I am concerned about how so few vets (including this one) engage in C4 and CNR schemes - seems like a pretty awful symptom of the buying  up of independent practices by profit driven equity firms.

I've called several times to help me deal with a feral cat population but no response.

Cat shelters are heaving. Vets need to do better.
Exceptional and very kind service of my dog!

My dog got spade this week and was in the best hands.
They took very good care of her and did not have any worries regarding her care with them.
I was given good solid advice no beating around the bush with anything.
As for price I'm not sure this was the first spade I have ever had to do so not sure on price ranges. But the team are worth every penny.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐ We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us such a lovely rating. It means a lot to the whole team, and we’re so pleased you had a positive experience with us.

Thank you for your 4-star review! We’re really pleased you had a positive experience with us. We’d love to know if there’s anything we could have done to make your experience a 5-star one, so please feel free to share any feedback with us.
I really loved it. My Maggie got spayed today. Afterwards the vet explained to me very well.loved their service 5 ⭐️

I took my puppies for their 1st jabs,was given a single tablet per puppy at a unaware cost of £17 per single tablet and yet the product is available for a whole box for the sum of £17 ….. so how much of a mark up do they think is acceptable and not???…….. what a total rip off to customers
Excellent used them as part of the C4 scheme. Staff are all wonderful!
Medivets Is a very friendly service the staff are amazing polite and they help and give advice when needed about your pet and I’m very impressed overall with the services
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐ We are delighted you had a great experience with our team. ❤️
Always professional, always friendly, and very accommodating.
Really friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Easy booking. Great staff. Everyone so friendly and reassuring
Staff are very friendly, knowledgeable and attentive. The branch is super clean. My appointment was on time and handled with care. I  very happy with the service.
Taking care of our pet just fine. Excellent service and very friendly staff
Friendly staff and everything went well for my cat Darya. Thanks
lovely staff, great care
Amazing stuff, very helpful. Quick service my pets seem happy for they visit. They would highly recommend this place
Chloe the veterinary nurse is amazing! Thanks for the amazing service.
Was really nice and friendly and explained the after care of my cats surgery brilliantly
Thank you for your review! We appreciate it.
Everyone was super lovely, friendly and helpful to me and my XL bully. It meant so much and I couldn’t be more appreciative of everyone for making us feel comfortable and welcome

This is one of the best Medivet clinics we have visited so far. Dr Zoi is a great vet, she is very knowledgeable, attentive, and caring. Chloe is also lovely and incredibly helpful. I appreciate the support, attention, and care they showed to my boy.

This is my first time coming here Great service from this Practice to book a appointment for my kittens neutering it was nice easy simple she was very friendly when I took my kitten for his appointment and post op check up all the staff very very nice helpful and explained everything clearly very much appreciate the great service
Very kind and helpful. Lovely nurses.

I’ve been a loyal customer at Medivet Dalston for nearly 4 years, paying monthly for both my Persian cats and even recommending family to the practice. Sadly, my recent visit on 31/10/2025 with Michele left me really upset and disappointed.

I arrived about 15–20 minutes late due to traffic and apologised as soon as I got there, but was met with a rude and dismissive attitude. The vet rushed through the appointment, cut my cat’s nail too short which made it bleed, and refused to prescribe medication for their eyes, saying it was a “free health check” — even though I’ve been a paying customer for years.

After always trusting and supporting this clinic, I expected kindness and understanding, not to be made to feel like an inconvenience. Very disappointed with how I was treated.
Friendly staff and warm vibe.
Always lovely to us humans as well as our fur babies.  The support they gave me when it was tike to say goodbye to my 16 year old Princess was amazing. ❤️
My dog has seen Dr Zoe and Dr Huw who are both amazing vets, always very clean practice and greeted with a smile at reception ❤️ very helpful staff can't fault them

I was registered with Medivet and booked a EHC travel test for my cat, and need to fill in the government form every time I apply. So firstly islington cross street canceled after they said they can do it and after I filled in the form, then I need to call many different locations. According to Islington Cross street vet, they said the clerkenwell one can do it. Then the clerenwell one told me they couldn’t and suggested me to try other vets. I made few phone calls , the Finsbury Park staff even didn’t know what’s EHC test for travel. Then Dalston vet promised me they can do it and charged the deposit fee. The they changed to different vet without notice, and want to charge me full price before the test. I never heard of this policy from any other vet. And also I had many communication problems and misunderstandings while booking this EHC test with medivet for many times, the staff aren’t professional and helpful. And when I tried to cancel it because it already wasted so much of my time, they said they won’t know when will the deposit be refunded I need to wait for your bank group’s call, and yet still no email, no reply from the bank. I am disappointed about the whole process.
Moon pie and sunflower had amazing 1st time experience. So well taken care of.

I originally booked vaccinations for my three brand new puppies at 8 weeks, taking advantage of a promotional rate of £19.99 per puppy. I confirmed with the receptionist beforehand and was advised to bring £59.97 total.

However, when I arrived, I was surprised to be charged £90.91 over £30 more than expected without any prior explanation. I was told one of the puppies needed the same vaccination for £60, which hadn’t been mentioned during booking. Had I known, I might have explored more cost-effective options.

On a positive note, the clinic was clean and the staff were friendly throughout my visit. But due to the lack of clear communication and unexpected pricing, I wouldn’t recommend Medivet Dalston based on transparency alone.
